# @jswork/antd-form-schema-crud

Ant Design schema-driven CRUD. Two components:

- SchemaCrudForm: one record. create / view / edit / delete, driven by @jswork/antd-form-schema.
- SchemaCrudList: one resource list. server-side pagination, columns, row actions, delete.

## Install

pnpm add @jswork/antd-form-schema-crud @jswork/antd-form-schema@^1.0.3

@jswork/antd-form-schema is a peer dependency; install it explicitly in the host project.

## List contract

SchemaCrudList calls nx.$api[`${resource}_index`] with:

  { page, size, ...params }

and expects:

  { rows: TRecord[], total: number }

`page` and `size` are owned by the component. Unwrap any API envelope in the adapter. The four key names are configurable globally through `configureSchemaCrudList({ keys })`.

## Minimal list

```tsx
<SchemaCrudList
  resource="posts"
  schema={postSchema}
  title="文章"
  presets={postListPresets}
  onCreate={() => navigate('/posts/new')}
  onEdit={(record) => navigate(`/posts/${record.id}/edit`)}
/>
```

List does not import react-router. Navigation is entirely callback-driven.

Route-backed pagination: pass controlled `page` and write it back in `onPageChange(page, pageSize)`. The list initializes from `page`, so a refresh keeps the current page. The callback also fires on params reset and delete page rollback.

## Query slots

`SchemaCrudList` owns user query state. `params` stays fixed; `query.values` is the user-filter layer merged as:

  { ...query.values, ...params, page, size }

`query` only supports named slots. Do not use query.render, query.position, query.controls or query.controlsSlot. Every slot is a function receiving the same `values`, `setValues`, `reset` and `loading`:

```tsx
<SchemaCrudList
  resource="posts"
  schema={postSchema}
  params={{ tenant_id: 1 }}
  query={{
    defaultValues: { keywords: undefined, status: 'open' },
    urlKeys: { keywords: 'q' },
    slots: {
      headerStart: ({ values }) => <Tag>{values.status}</Tag>,
      headerEnd: ({ values, setValues, reset }) => (
        <>
          <Input.Search
            value={values.keywords ?? ''}
            onChange={(event) => setValues({ keywords: event.target.value || undefined })}
          />
          <Button onClick={() => reset()}>Reset</Button>
        </>
      ),
      body: ({ values, setValues }) => (
        <DateRangePicker value={values.range} onChange={(range) => setValues({ range })} />
      ),
    },
  }}
/>
```

- Slots: `before` above the Card, `headerStart` before built-in actions, `headerEnd` after built-in actions, `body` inside the Card body before the table.
- `defaultValues` is the only initialization baseline for all slots. It can be an object or a lazy function evaluated once with `{ searchParams, location }`.
- Query values are independent of the row shape. `SchemaCrudList<PostRecord, PostListQuery>` types `values` / `setValues` / `reset` with the second generic; it defaults to a string-keyed record.
- URL query values override `defaultValues`; `urlKeys` accepts an array or `{ queryKey: urlKey }`; `url: false` disables URL sync.
- Query changes reset to page 1 by default. `setValues(patch, { resetPage: false })` keeps the current page.
- `reset()` restores defaultValues; `reset({})` clears; `reset(values)` uses a one-time reset value. All reset page 1.
- Query keys equal to page/size keys are ignored. Fixed `params` win over query values with the same key.


## Minimal form

```tsx
<SchemaCrudForm
  resource="posts"
  schema={postSchema}
  id={id}
  title="文章"
  onBack={() => navigate('/posts')}
/>
```

`id` absent => create. `id` present => view by default; internal edit switch. Controlled mode: pass `mode` and `onModeChange`.

`mode="form"` is the one-page create/edit variant: no id => create, id present => edit immediately, never view. Saving stays in edit and reloads the record; cancel and delete call `onBack`.

Create/edit save with Cmd+S (macOS) or Ctrl+S (Windows/Linux); the browser Save dialog is suppressed. The shortcut shares the save button's conditions (form ready, no request in flight, dirty in edit). View mode does not bind it. Create/edit also show a small gray `⌘/Ctrl + S 保存` hint on the left side of the footer.

Title bar: icon-only back on the left when `onBack` exists. Footer toolbar: all actions are right-aligned in one group, delete first, then cancel/back, then the primary action. It has a top border and a light background.

## External actions

Mounted list and form expose actions through React hooks. No ref and no window events.

```tsx
const list = useCrudListActions('posts');
const form = useCrudFormActions('posts');

list.reload(); list.create(); list.edit(record); await list.remove(record);
form.submit(); form.reload(); form.edit(); form.cancel(); await form.remove();
```

- Scope defaults to `resource`; override with `actionScope`.
- Hooks return `ready: false` plus no-op actions before the instance mounts, and update after registration/unmount.
- List and form scopes are isolated, so both can use `'posts'`.
- One instance per surface + scope. A duplicate logs an error in development and the first instance keeps ownership.
- `remove` skips Popconfirm and returns a Promise; callers own confirmation. `submit` returns void; results arrive through onSuccess / onError.
- All actions reuse the built-in button handlers and guards, including router navigation, pagination rollback and `mode="form"` reload behavior.

Form defaults: `layout="horizontal"`, `labelCol={{ flex: '100px' }}`, `wrapperCol={{ style: { flexGrow: 1, flexShrink: 1, flexBasis: 0, minWidth: 0 } }}`. Override through `formProps`. The title has an icon-only back; footer carries the text actions. `Card.extra` is caller-owned content.

## Field selection

- `SchemaCrudList.fields?: readonly string[]`: restrict schema-derived columns, in order. Omitted = all; explicit `columns` wins; unknown and schema-hidden fields are skipped.
- `SchemaCrudForm.viewFields?: readonly string[]`: restrict fields in view mode, in order. Create/edit always use the full schema.

Per business, keep one plain config object for `list.fields` and `detail.fields`; pass them to the two components.

## List presets

```ts
const presets: ListPresets = {
  fields: {
    title: { title: '标题', width: 240 },
    status: { title: '状态', width: 100, align: 'center' },
  },
};
```

Column priority: explicit `columns` > `fields` > `presets` > `schema.fields.label` > field key. `fields` only filters schema-derived columns.
Presets only decorate existing schema fields; they never add columns. `hidden: true` removes a derived column without touching the form field. No `render` in presets.

## Actions

- create: `actions.create !== false` and `onCreate`
- edit: `actions.edit !== false` and `onEdit`; the only row navigation entry
- delete: `actions.delete !== false` and resolved `destroy`
- refresh: `actions.refresh !== false`, shown by default
- back: `onBack` present

## Defaults

- Shared: both form and list Cards use `size='middle'`; change once with `configureSchemaCrud({ cardSize })`, read with `getSchemaCrudDefaults()`, reset with `resetSchemaCrudDefaults()`.
- List: pageSize 10, rowKey 'id', confirmDelete true, bordered table, size small.
- List keys default to page / size / rows / total; configure once with `configureSchemaCrudList({ keys })`, read effective keys with `getSchemaCrudListDefaults()`, reset with `resetSchemaCrudListDefaults()`.
- Delete success: reload; if current page becomes empty and page > 1, go back one page.
- Form success: single `onSuccess(event)` with action create / update / delete.

## Global form defaults

configureSchemaCrudForm({ title, confirmDelete, actions, formProps })
getSchemaCrudFormDefaults()
resetSchemaCrudFormDefaults()

List does not read these form defaults.

## Style

import '@jswork/antd-form-schema-crud/style.css'

- `SchemaCrudList` syncs page/size with the router query by default (`?page=1&size=10`), following the global list page/size keys. It supports `keepDefaultParams` and `onPageChange`; passing `page` or `pageSize` makes pagination controlled and disables URL syncing. Outside a router it falls back to internal pagination. In a router it also defaults onCreate to `${pathname}/add${search}`, onEdit to `${pathname}/${rowKey}/edit${search}`, delete success to a toast, and error to an error toast; each handler can be overridden.
